entities.summary: The Historic Synagogue Justo Sierra 71, formerly known as Nidjei Israel Synagogue, is an Orthodox Jewish congregation, synagogue, and cultural center, located at Justo Sierra 71, in the historic center of Mexico City, in Mexico. The building was completed in 1941 and serves both as a synagogue and cultural center of the Ashkenazi Jewish community.
